List of Mandatory Documents to attached by the Candidates:
Applicants should keep self-attested photocopies of the following documents:
• Proof of Date of Birth – Birth Certificate / SSLC / HSC Certificate.
• Educational Qualification and Marks – SSLC, HSC, DGNM / B.Sc. Nursing certificate.
• Tamil Nadu Nurses and Midwives Council Registration Certificate.
• Proof of Tamil eligibility – 10th or 12th Standard mark sheet.
• Proof of Residence – any one of the following:
i. Voter ID
ii. Aadhaar Card
iii. Ration Card
• Character and Conduct Certificate issued by a Group A or Group B Government Officer, dated
within the last 3 months.
• Any other certificate relevant to the applicable scoring criteria, Transgender / Ex-Servicemen/
Destitute Widow wherever applicable.
Two recent passport-size colour photographs.
• Community Certificate
I hereby declare that the information furnished above is true and correct to the best of my knowledge. I am
aware that the Staff Nurse post is purely temporary on a contractual basis under the National Health Mission
– Tamil Nadu and that the services will not be regularised for any reason.
